questions.question: Explain what volume is and why cubes are used to measure it.
questions.expected_answer: Volume is the amount of space an object takes up or holds. Cubes are used because they pack together with no gaps, so counting them measures all the space.

questions.question: A box is 4 cubes long, 3 cubes wide and 2 cubes high. Find its volume and explain your method.
questions.expected_answer: The bottom layer has 3 rows of 4, which is 12 cubes. There are 2 layers, so 12 plus 12 is 24 cubes. The volume is 24 cubic units.

questions.question: A jug takes 8 cups of water to fill and a bowl takes 5 cups. Which holds more, and what must be true about the cups?
questions.expected_answer: The jug holds more, 3 cups more. The cups must all be the same size and filled the same way each time, or the comparison is not fair.
